description: This Java class 'CommandEndpointConfiguration' defines configuration and behavior related to command endpoints in test scenarios for the Hono project. It includes options for subscriber roles, legacy endpoint handling, and methods for generating endpoint addresses.

classes.name: CommandEndpointConfiguration
classes.description: Class providing configuration and utility methods for command endpoint testing scenarios.

classes.name: CommandEndpointConfiguration.SubscriberRole
classes.description: Enum defining different subscription roles for command scenarios.

methods.name: CommandEndpointConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor initializing the configuration with specific subscriber role and endpoint legacy flags.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current configuration.

methods.name: getSouthboundEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name used by devices, considering legacy settings.

methods.name: isSubscribeAsGateway
methods.description: Checks if subscription is as a gateway for all devices or a single device.

methods.name: isSubscribeAsGatewayForAllDevices
methods.description: Checks if subscription is as a gateway for all connected devices.

methods.name: isSubscribeAsGatewayForSingleDevice
methods.description: Checks if subscription is as a gateway for a single device.

methods.name: isLegacyNorthboundEndpoint
methods.description: Indicates whether the application uses the legacy northbound endpoint.

methods.name: getNorthboundEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the current endpoint used for sending commands, considering legacy setting.

methods.name: getCommandMessageAddress
methods.description: Generates the target address for command messages sent to a device.

methods.name: getSenderLinkTargetAddress
methods.description: Generates the target address for the sender link to send commands, considering legacy endpoint.
